# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by go run ./tools/gendocs from internal/config/config.go. Do not edit by hand. -->

LANLeecher reads one YAML file, given by `--config` or `LANLEECHER_CONFIG` (default
`/etc/lanleecher/config.yaml`). Switches, ports, users and API tokens are not configured here;
they live in the database and are managed in the web UI.

- Relative paths are relative to the directory of the configuration file.
- Durations use Go syntax: `30s`, `10m`, `1h30m`.
- Unknown keys are ignored. For editor validation, point your YAML language server at
  [config.schema.json](config.schema.json).
- Changes take effect after a restart (`sudo systemctl restart lanleecher`).

An annotated example is in [configs/lanleecher.example.yaml](../configs/lanleecher.example.yaml).

## Top level

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `listen` | string | `127.0.0.1:9040` | The HTTP listen address, e.g. "127.0.0.1:9040". |
| `public_url` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:9040` | The externally visible base URL. If it starts with https://, session cookies are marked Secure. |
| `trusted_proxies` | []string | `[127.0.0.1, ::1]` | The proxy IPs or networks whose X-Real-IP / X-Forwarded-For headers are trusted for client IPs (rate limits, audit log). |
| `secret_key_file` | string | `secret.key` | The file with the AES-256 key that encrypts credentials in the database (64 hex characters). It is created if missing. |

## `storage` – Configures the SQLite database

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `storage.path` | string | `data/lanleecher.db` | The SQLite database file. Its directory is created if missing. |

## `log` – Configures logging

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `log.level` | string | `info` | The minimum log level. Allowed: `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`. |
| `log.format` | string | `text` | The log output format. Allowed: `text`, `json`. |

## `polling` – Holds the polling defaults for switches

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `polling.interval` | duration | `30s` | The time between two counter polls of a switch. Switches can override it. |
| `polling.fdb_interval` | duration | `1m` | The time between two reads of a switch's forwarding table (MAC → port). It is never shorter than polling.interval. |
| `polling.timeout` | duration | `3s` | The timeout of a single SNMP request. |
| `polling.retries` | int | `1` | The number of retries of a single SNMP request. |
| `polling.uplink_mac_threshold` | int | `10` | Marks ports with more MACs than this as "probably uplink". |

## `resolver` – Configures IP and hostname discovery

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resolver.order` | []string | `[snmp-arp, local-neigh, netbios, mdns, dns-ptr]` | Lists the enabled resolvers. An empty list turns IP and hostname discovery off. Allowed: `snmp-arp`, `local-neigh`, `netbios`, `mdns`, `llmnr`, `dns-ptr`. |
| `resolver.hostname_priority` | []string | `[dhcp, netbios, mdns, llmnr, dns-ptr]` | Ranks hostname sources when choosing the displayed name; earlier sources win. Allowed: `dhcp`, `netbios`, `mdns`, `llmnr`, `dns-ptr`. |
| `resolver.probe_interval` | duration | `10m` | How often NetBIOS, mDNS, LLMNR and DNS are asked again for the name of each active IP. New IPs are probed immediately. |
| `resolver.probe_rate` | int | `20` | The maximum number of name queries per second. |
| `resolver.probe_timeout` | duration | `1s` | The timeout of a single NetBIOS, mDNS or LLMNR query. |

## `board` – Configures the beamer view

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `board.enabled` | bool | `false` | Turns on the beamer view at /board. |
| `board.public` | bool | `false` | Makes /board and the board API reachable without login or token. |

## `api` – Configures the REST API

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api.metrics_enabled` | bool | `true` | Serves Prometheus metrics at /api/v1/metrics. |
| `api.rate_limit` | float | `10` | The sustained number of API requests per second per token or logged-in user. |
| `api.rate_burst` | int | `30` | The number of requests a token may send at once. |

## `tls` – Enables the built-in TLS listener; usually a reverse proxy does this

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tls.cert_file` | string | `–` | The PEM certificate (chain). Set together with tls.key_file. |
| `tls.key_file` | string | `–` | The PEM private key. |
